messages.subject: For Margherita Della Valle | Telecom, government relations and regional stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Vodafone Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Margherita Della Valle, Group Chief Executive.

Vodafone's next phase of growth across connectivity, infrastructure and digital services depends on disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, strategic partners and operating companies. That interface closely matches my current work.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex stakeholder matters across regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, regional strategy and emerging-market execution might support Vodafone's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Vodafone Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
